question.text: Under SEBI (ICDR) Reg 292D and related operational guidelines, the minimum tenure of a Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) instrument issued by an NPO on the SSE is:

explanation.text: The Logic: ZCZP instruments — being non-interest-bearing and non-principal-repaying — are designed as philanthropic contributions with a programme horizon. Reg 292D operational guidelines prescribe a MINIMUM tenure of 3 years, allowing adequate time for programme execution, outcome realisation, and SIA-certified AIRs at least twice during the instrument's life. The Trap: 6 months and 1 year are too short for meaningful outcome measurement. 5 years overstates the minimum (although longer tenures are permitted voluntarily). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D/E (AIF) uses different tenure rules for Cat I SVF; XXIII tests the ZCZP 3-year minimum specifically. Do not confuse SVF minimum tenure with ZCZP minimum tenure. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Align your SIA engagement letter tenure with the ZCZP tenure — if the ZCZP is 3 years, plan annual AIR for 3 years, with interim sampling and a terminal aggregate assessment. This pre-commits evidence-gathering at each milestone, avoiding 'year-3 scramble'.
